headline: SpaceX Catches Starship Upper Stage in Texas After Orbital Flight
deck: The upper stage returned to Starbase’s launch tower after its orbital flight and deployed 26 Starlink V3 satellites.
body: SpaceX caught Starship’s upper stage with the launch tower at Starbase, Texas, after its flight from space, the first capture of a Starship returning from space. [E1][E2]
The spacecraft returned to Earth 22 hours after its journey began, NPR reported. [E3]
Friends of NASA reported that Starship deployed 26 Starlink V3 satellites after reaching orbit. [E4]

evidence_box.fragment: Then, less than a minute after it came into view, the Starship upper stage was snagged by the launch tower, as snug as you like.
